Great to meet you and the Acme security team on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Recap: You had three primary asks: (1) SOC 2 evidence and current compliance posture, (2) specifics on audit logging (admin activity, API request logs, retention/exportability), and (3) initiation of the vendor security questionnaire.

- What I’ll share today: Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), our audit log schema (CSV), and a one-click link to start the questionnaire so your procurement/security team can assign reviewers.

- Audit logging notes we discussed (high level):

  - Export: S3 export or API export (JSON/CSV), daily and near-real-time options
  - Immutability: append-only storage with retention policies; enterprise Dedicated/Private options can support write-once cold storage for long-term retention

Next steps:

2) Start the questionnaire here: https://redwood-inference.app/questionnaire/D-14287-start (I’ll get notified when it’s assigned).
3) Can we schedule a short follow-up with our solutions engineer to demo S3 export and show immutability controls? I’m available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks — happy to jump on another call with your infra/security folks.

Best,

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and fast follow-up. A few clarifying questions from my side and from our security lead:

1) SOC 2: Is the Type II report scoped to production (hosted) infrastructure and does it include vendor-hosted deployments? Any gap list?
2) Immutability: Can you describe the guarantee? Is it append-only with WORM (write once read many) capabilites? Can we get tamper-evidence logs?
3) Exports: We prefer daily S3 exports to a customer-owned bucket with object-lock enabled. Do you support direct delivery into our S3 buckets and can you preserve original request_id + timestamps in exported files?
4) API logs: Can we get raw request/response metadata (headers, model version, token counts) for troubleshooting? Any PII redaction options?
5) HIPAA/GDPR: Do you sign BAAs for handling PHI? Any GDPR DPA in place?

We’ll also start the vendor questionnaire on our side but wanted answers to the above before we route to procurement.

Thanks — Danielle

Hi Danielle —

Thanks for the great questions. Answers below (high level) — happy to follow up with an SE-led demo to show configuration and exports in our console.

1) SOC 2: Our most recent SOC 2 Type II audit (period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) covers our hosted production environment and controls across change management, logging, monitoring, and access controls. The redacted report is attached (full scope available under NDA). Open items/gaps are tracked in our compliance backlog; none are material to logging controls for production.

2) Immutability / tamper evidence:
  - Logs are written to an append-only store with cryptographic checksums computed per-file and per-batch.
  - For enterprise Dedicated/Private customers we support write-once storage patterns and can deliver exports using S3 Object Lock (governance/compliance modes) to a customer-owned bucket.
  - We maintain tamper-evidence via signed manifests and can provide a hash chain on request for audit purposes.

3) Exports / delivery:
  - We support scheduled exports to a customer-owned S3 bucket (direct delivery) or ad-hoc export via our Audit Export API. Exports include original request_id, timestamps (UTC), model_version, token counts, and a pointer to stored inputs/outputs (when retention is enabled).
  - Export formats: JSON (structured), CSV (flattened). Files are gzipped for transit.

4) API logs / PII:
  - API request logs capture request_id, caller identity, model_version, prompt metadata (size, token counts), response metadata (latency, status), and telemetry. We do not persist unredacted customer prompt texts in the default short-retention configuration; for customers that require full request retention we can enable prompt retention with explicit contractual terms.
  - PII redaction: we offer configurable redaction pipelines (regex-based and DLP integrations).

5) HIPAA / GDPR:
  - We have a GDPR DPA; we can sign standard and tailored DPAs.
  - For HIPAA, we offer BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted accounts we evaluate on a case-by-case basis depending on data flows and contractual needs.

Attachments included again for your team:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted)
- log_schema_v1.csv (fields & example rows)
- audit_export_instructions.txt (how to configure S3 export and retention)

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll start the questionnaire link for you: https://redwood-inference.app/questionnaire/D-14287-start
- Schedule a 45 min demo with Dev (our SE) to walk through S3 export and immutability (I can do Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 9–11am PT).

If you want, I can also loop in our compliance lead for a short call on SOC 2 scope.

Best,
Marissa
